Added S-5816 (empty shell, Lead ROUND 144 ruling item 6, not fixed here) and P-0002/P-0004/P-0008/P-0009/P-0010/P-0011 (the 6 ROUND-189 pre-settlements AUTH-074 emptied on purpose to restore views.live_loads -- each still carries its load via mdata.loads.presettlement_link_id, the guard's own documented open+loaded exception). Removed all 6 from this list: the guard's live re-run now excludes them on its own via the corrected predicate, not via a baseline entry -- keeping them here would be a redundant, silently-stale exception nobody would ever notice going wrong.
